name: Heart Disease
application: Diagnosis of coronary artery disease (angiographic) classification
file_formats: Comma-delimited .data files (cleveland.data, hungarian.data, switzerland.data, long-beach-va.data, new.data); data.csv via API
feature_count: 13 features (subset of 14 used out of 76 attributes)
target: num: diagnosis of heart disease (angiographic disease status), integer 0 (no presence) to 4; usually binarised presence vs absence
geographic_coverage: 4 databases: Cleveland, Hungary, Switzerland, VA Long Beach
collection_method: Clinical records from 4 sites; patient identifiers removed and replaced with dummy values
download_method: Direct HTTPS download of zip from UCI landing page or ucimlrepo Python package
citation: Janosi, A., Steinbrunn, W., Pfisterer, M., & Detrano, R. (1989). Heart Disease [Dataset]. UCI ML Repository. https://doi.org/10.24432/C52P4X; intro paper Detrano et al. 1989, Am J Cardiol
limitations: 303 rows; only Cleveland subset widely used; 76 raw attributes but 14 used in published work
verification_method: WebFetch of UCI landing page + UCI API JSON (id=45; record name matches Heart Disease)

name: Pima Indians Diabetes (OpenML 'diabetes')
application: Binary prediction of diabetes onset
subject_count: 768 female patients of Pima Indian heritage, aged 21+
geographic_coverage: Pima Indian heritage population (per OpenML description)
collection_method: Originally from National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases, via UCI
download_method: Direct download / OpenML API (openml-python, sklearn fetch_openml)
citation: Smith et al. (1988) ADAP; OpenML citation link https://www.jair.org/index.php/jair/article/view/10129
limitations: Original UCI URL https://archive.ics.uci.edu/ml/datasets/pima+indians+diabetes listed as original_data_url; UCI entry no longer listed. Assessment: zeros in glucose/BP/BMI etc. are known disguised missing values despite 0 reported missing
mirrors: Original UCI page (legacy URL recorded by OpenML)
verification_method: WebFetch of OpenML JSON data API + data qualities API
